messages:
chloe: opened PR #5120 to add a 'seed-relay daemon' section for private/on-prem installs. goal: a lightweight relay that fetches the bootstrap bundle once, verifies checksum, and exposes it on a local unix socket for installers to pull. preview: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5120

infra-bot: CI: docs build passed  preview: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5120 (build 9350)

raj: neat idea. can we show both systemd unit + a minimal tini wrapper example? some customers like running a small container for the relay instead of a host unit.

chloe: yep will add both. container example will use `curl --fail --retry 4 --connect-timeout 8 --tlsv1.2 -o /opt/seed/bundle.tgz` and `sha256sum -c /opt/seed/bundle.sha256`.

kim: KMS/HSM note: mention PKCS#11 socket differences across vendors and include an env sample: `PKCS11_SOCKET=/var/run/pkcs11/slot0.sock` and fallback paths in examples. also add a line: "if your appliance exposes a TCP proxy for PKCS#11, prefer the vendor guide."

chloe: added env var and vendor note. also included a tiny snippet how to set `LD_PRELOAD` for customers using certain PKCS#11 shims.

raj: small security ask: recommend `chmod 640` on /opt/seed and ensure bundle deleted after install. maybe show `ExecStartPost=/bin/sh -c 'rm -f /opt/seed/bundle.tgz && chmod 700 /opt/seed'` in systemd.

chloe: added ExecStartPost cleanup and the line: "treat bundles as secrets; rotate/delete after bootstrap."

kim: troubleshooting suggestion: add note about MTU + VPN overlays causing partial downloads. include `curl --header "Range: bytes=0-"` is NOT supported for our bundles, so recommend checking MTU or using `--limit-rate` temporarily.

raj: also include `REDWOOD_SEED_MODE=seed-only` example for operators who want to disable model-registry calls during bootstrap. saved us in one customer test.

infra-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5120?update=2 (build 9353)

chloe: also added a short section on conn-checker: example `redwood-conn-check --target seed-relay:443 --timeout 5s` and an anchor to the main conn-checker CLI page.

docs-bot: Reminder: PR #5120 missing label `needs-legal`. Please confirm if text requires export-control review.

chloe: text is operational guidance only, no crypto algorithm details. I'll ping legal for a quick ack and add a one-line note asking customers to follow their local export rules.

legal-bot: FYI: Legal requested a short ack sentence. Suggest: "Operators should follow applicable export and cryptography policies when transferring certificates across borders."

chloe: added legal line per legal-bot. also tightened wording on checksum verification and added an example `bundle.sha256` content: `3b7e...  bundle.tgz`.

kim: tiny nit: anchor name mismatch in 'cleanup' checklist (page links to `#bundle-cleanup` but the heading is `#cleanup-bundle`). I'll push a one-line fix to the branch.

raj: LGTM after anchor fix and CI green. nice docs for semi-airgap flow.

infra-bot: CI: preview updated  https://deploy-preview.internal.redwood/5120?update=3 (build 9357)

chloe: final plan: merge after anchor fix and thumbs from kim and raj. ETA today PST. thanks! :rocket:
